parsed.rationale: All eleven records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on what the cluster_id indicates is `EnvironmentValues`, spread across six distinct packages: `AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, and `PlayerHeaderView`. In SwiftUI, extending `EnvironmentValues` to inject a custom key is the canonical, idiomatic pattern — each extension is necessarily scoped to the package that owns the corresponding environment key (e.g., `PlaylistServiceEnvironment.swift`, `AccentColorEnvironment.swift`, `RadioPlayerControllerEnvironment.swift`). The structural collision is purely nominal: every file extends the same SwiftUI type, but each extension encodes a distinct, domain-specific environment value with no shared members (`fields_or_signature` is empty on every record). Consolidating these extensions would couple unrelated packages and violate the separation of concerns that motivates the per-package injection pattern.
